system.description:
The first art of the true assassin is to move in perfect silence, drawing a field of quiet about yourself that swallows every scream, gunshot and explosion.

Spend one Blood Trait to muffle all sound within ten feet of yourself; the effect lasts a scene or an hour. Sound from outside the radius can still travel in and be heard, but nothing near you makes any noise that reaches beyond the field.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
